daas-irab:46-47.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَراغِبٌ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and [راغب is] a fronted khabar (predicate); beginning with an indefinite noun is permitted because it occurs after the interrogative. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿عَنْ آلِهَتِي﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) راغب; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿إِبْراهِيمُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the implied (muqaddar) أدعو; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾ the lām is the one that prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); in is a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a jussive particle. ﴿تَنْتَهِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of the oath, and an imperfect verb indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil is latent and the kāf is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer of an oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted. ﴿وَاهْجُرْنِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿مَلِيًّا﴾ an adverb of time; [it is] attached to اهجرني. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَلامٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ; what licenses beginning with it [as an indefinite] is the meaning of supplication in it. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ﴾ the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿لَكَ﴾ attached to أستغفر. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; its clause is the khabar of إنه. ﴿بِي﴾ attached to حفيا. ﴿حَفِيًّا﴾ the khabar of kāna.

daas-irab:48-49.t: ﴿وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the kāf is its object; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a relative noun conjoined to the kāf before it. ﴿تَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) تدعون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَأَدْعُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the wāw owing to heaviness; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَسى﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, one of the verbs of hope; its noun is omitted. ﴿أَلَّا﴾ an is the particle that makes the verb accusative, and lā is negative. ﴿أَكُونَ﴾ an incomplete imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an; its noun is omitted, its implied form being "أنا". ﴿بِدُعاءِ﴾ attached to شقيا. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿شَقِيًّا﴾ the khabar (predicate) of يكون; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as the khabar of عسى. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and لما is adverbial, conditional, non-jussive. ﴿اعْتَزَلَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and mā is a relative noun conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يَعْبُدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ attached to يعبدون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَهَبْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to وهبنا. ﴿إِسْحاقَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَيَعْقُوبَ﴾ conjoined to إسحق. ﴿وَكُلًّا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and كلا is the first mafʿūl bihi of جعلنا. ﴿جَعَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿نَبِيًّا﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:50-53.t: ﴿وَوَهَبْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) وهبنا. ﴿مِنْ رَحْمَتِنا﴾ attached to وهبنا; nā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَجَعَلْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ attached to جعلنا. ﴿لِسانَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿صِدْقٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلِيًّا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of لسان. ﴿وَاذْكُرْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي الْكِتابِ﴾ attached to اذكر. ﴿مُوسى﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. [Translator's note: there is no wāw on كان in the text of the verse; the source's mention of it appears to be a slip.] ﴿مُخْلَصاً﴾ the khabar (predicate) of kāna; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿وَكانَ﴾ a conjunction, and an incomplete past verb whose noun is omitted; the clause is conjoined. ﴿رَسُولًا نَبِيًّا﴾ two khabars of kāna. ﴿وَنادَيْناهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ جانِبِ﴾ attached to ناديناه. ﴿الطُّورِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْأَيْمَنِ﴾ an adjective. ﴿وَقَرَّبْناهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿نَجِيًّا﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَوَهَبْنا﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to وهبنا. ﴿مِنْ رَحْمَتِنا﴾ attached to وهبنا; nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَخاهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the alif because it is one of the five nouns; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هارُونَ﴾ badal (substitute) of أخاه. ﴿نَبِيًّا﴾ ḥāl.

daas-irab:54-57.t: ﴿وَاذْكُرْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي الْكِتابِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) اذكر. ﴿إِسْماعِيلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is omitted. ﴿صادِقَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of kāna; the clause is the khabar of إنه. ﴿الْوَعْدِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَكانَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an incomplete past verb whose noun is omitted. ﴿رَسُولًا نَبِيًّا﴾ the two khabars of kāna, both accusative (manṣūb); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَكانَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an incomplete past verb; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَأْمُرُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of kāna. ﴿أَهْلَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِالصَّلاةِ﴾ attached to يأمر. ﴿وَالزَّكاةِ﴾ conjoined to الصلاة, and it is genitive (majrūr) like it. ﴿وَكانَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an incomplete past verb; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to مرضيا. ﴿رَبِّهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَرْضِيًّا﴾ the khabar of kāna. ﴿وَاذْكُرْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الْكِتابِ﴾ attached to اذكر. ﴿إِدْرِيسَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is causal. ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete past verb whose noun is latent; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿صِدِّيقاً﴾ the khabar of kāna. ﴿نَبِيًّا﴾ a second khabar of kāna. ﴿وَرَفَعْناهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَكاناً﴾ an adverb of place, attached to رفعناه. ﴿عَلِيًّا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of مكانا.

daas-irab:58-58.t: ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the kāf is for address; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, khabar (predicate). ﴿أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنعم. ﴿مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, badal (substitute) of النبيين with repetition of the preposition. ﴿آدَمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the kasra because it is a diptote. [Translator's note: the source says "by the kasra"; as a diptote, آدم is genitive by the fatḥa, as the text itself states for إبراهيم and إسرائيل below.] ﴿وَمِمَّنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and min is a preposition assimilated into the relative man; both are conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿حَمَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مَعَ﴾ an adverb attached to حملنا. ﴿نُوحٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿وَإِسْرائِيلَ﴾ conjoined to إبراهيم, [genitive] by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿وَمِمَّنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and min is a preposition assimilated into man, the relative noun; [both are] conjoined to what preceded. ﴿هَدَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَاجْتَبَيْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb containing the meaning of condition; it is a non-jussive conditional particle attached to the apodosis. ﴿تُتْلى﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ attached to تتلى. ﴿آياتُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿الرَّحْمنِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خَرُّوا﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is joined to the wāw of the plural; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿سُجَّداً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿وَبُكِيًّا﴾ conjoined to سجدا.

daas-irab:59-61.t: ﴿فَخَلَفَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلف; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿خَلْفٌ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what preceded. ﴿أَضاعُوا﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of nominative as an adjective (ṣifa) of خلف. ﴿الصَّلاةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَاتَّبَعُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿الشَّهَواتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿فَسَوْفَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and sawfa is for the future. ﴿يَلْقَوْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿غَيًّا﴾ mafʿūl bihi; its original form is غويا, and the wāw was assimilated into the yāʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, accusative as the excepted. ﴿تابَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَآمَنَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined by the wāw. ﴿وَعَمِلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined by the wāw. ﴿صالِحاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject); the kāf is for address; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَدْخُلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْجَنَّةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negative. ﴿يُظْلَمُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi of يظلمون. ﴿جَنَّاتِ﴾ badal (substitute) of الجنة in the previous verse, accusative by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿عَدْنٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative noun, an adjective of جنات. ﴿وَعَدَ الرَّحْمنُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿عِبادَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِالْغَيْبِ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿كانَ وَعْدُهُ مَأْتِيًّا﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar; the hāʾ in وعده is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar of إنه.

daas-irab:62-64.t: ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَسْمَعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِيها﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. while they are in Paradise. ﴿لَغْواً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿سَلاماً﴾ badal (substitute) of لغوا. ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿رِزْقُهُمْ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فِيها﴾ attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿بُكْرَةً﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿وَعَشِيًّا﴾ conjoined to بكرة. ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿الْجَنَّةُ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative, an adjective (ṣifa) of الجنة. ﴿نُورِثُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِنْ عِبادِنا﴾ attached to نورث. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is omitted. ﴿تَقِيًّا﴾ the khabar of kāna; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negative. ﴿نَتَنَزَّلُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿بِأَمْرِ﴾ attached to نتنزل. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative. ﴿أَيْدِينا﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and mā is a relative conjoined to the preceding mā. ﴿خَلْفَنا﴾ an adverb of place; nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما بَيْنَ﴾ conjoined to what preceded, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negative. ﴿كانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar; the kāf in ربك is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:65-67.t: ﴿رَبُّ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو", i.e. Allah. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and mā is a relative noun conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بَيْنَهُما﴾ an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَاعْبُدْهُ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), and an imperative verb and its object; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). The fāʾ is called faṣīḥa because it discloses (afṣaḥat) an implied condition. ﴿وَاصْطَبِرْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لِعِبادَتِهِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to اصطبر. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿تَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to تعلم. ﴿سَمِيًّا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَيَقُولُ الْإِنْسانُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَإِذا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and إذا is an adverb for future time, putting its condition in the genitive and made accusative by its apodosis. ﴿ما مِتُّ﴾ mā is redundant (zāʾida), and a past verb; the tāʾ is in the position of nominative as fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَسَوْفَ﴾ the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ) and sawfa is for the future. ﴿أُخْرَجُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb whose nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿حَيًّا﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَوَلا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negative. ﴿يَذْكُرُ الْإِنْسانُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّا﴾ anna, which resembles the verb, and nā, assimilated into it, is its noun; the clause is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) serving as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿خَلَقْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the khabar of أنا. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ min is a preposition, and qablu is an adverb indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of genitive; [both are] attached to خلقناه. ﴿وَلَمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lam is a jussive particle. ﴿يَكُ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the sukūn implied on the nūn that was deleted for lightening; its noun is omitted; the clause is conjoined. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ the khabar of يك.

daas-irab:68-71.t: ﴿فَوَ رَبِّكَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and the wāw is for the oath; ربك is a noun made genitive (majrūr) by the wāw of the oath, and [the two] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "أقسم". ﴿لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of the oath, and an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir) and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالشَّياطِينَ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of accompaniment (al-maʿiyya), and الشياطين is mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of an oath, and an imperfect verb indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿حَوْلَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to نحضرنهم. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿جِثِيًّا﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لَنَنْزِعَنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of the oath, and an imperfect verb indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ attached to ننزعن. ﴿شِيعَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَيُّهُمْ﴾ a relative noun meaning الذي, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَشَدُّ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو أشد". ﴿عَلَى الرَّحْمنِ﴾ attached to أشد. ﴿عِتِيًّا﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لَنَحْنُ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of the oath, and نحن is mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾ khabar. ﴿بِالَّذِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition and the relative noun is in the position of genitive by it; [the two are] attached to أعلم. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَوْلى﴾ khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿بِها﴾ attached to أولى. ﴿صِلِيًّا﴾ tamyīz; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and in is negative. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ attached to an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "أحد". ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿وارِدُها﴾ khabar; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is latent. ﴿عَلى رَبِّكَ﴾ attached to حتما. ﴿حَتْماً﴾ khabar. ﴿مَقْضِيًّا﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:72-74.t: ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿نُنَجِّي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اتَّقَوْا﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied on the alif that was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَنَذَرُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿فِيها﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) جثيا. ﴿جِثِيًّا﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb for future time, attached to its apodosis. ﴿تُتْلى﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ attached to تتلى. ﴿آياتُنا﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); nā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَيِّناتٍ﴾ ḥāl, accusative by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿قالَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a past verb, and the relative noun is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, [being] the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun is in the position of genitive by the lām, and [the two are] attached to قال. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَيُّ﴾ an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْفَرِيقَيْنِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿مَقاماً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَأَحْسَنُ﴾ conjoined to خير. ﴿نَدِيًّا﴾ tamyīz. ﴿وَكَمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and kam is declarative (khabariyya), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of أهلكنا. ﴿أَهْلَكْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿قَبْلَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿قَرْنٍ﴾ a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, tamyīz. ﴿هُمْ أَحْسَنُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of قرن. ﴿أَثاثاً﴾ tamyīz. ﴿وَرِءْياً﴾ conjoined to أثاثا.

daas-irab:75-76.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is latent. ﴿فِي الضَّلالَةِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿فَلْيَمْدُدْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, the lām is the lām of command, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to يمدد. ﴿الرَّحْمنُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿مَدًّا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb for future time, attached to the apodosis. ﴿رَأَوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يُوعَدُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِمَّا﴾ a particle of condition and detailing. ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾ badal (substitute) of mā. ﴿وَإِمَّا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and immā is conjoined to the preceding immā. ﴿السَّاعَةَ﴾ badal of mā. ﴿فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the answer of immā, the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿هُوَ شَرٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مَكاناً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَأَضْعَفُ﴾ conjoined to شر. ﴿جُنْداً﴾ tamyīz. ﴿وَيَزِيدُ اللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اهْتَدَوْا﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif that was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿هُدىً﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi of يزيد, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa implied on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿وَالْباقِياتُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a nominative mubtadaʾ. ﴿الصَّالِحاتُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ثَواباً﴾ tamyīz. ﴿وَخَيْرٌ﴾ conjoined to the preceding خير. ﴿مَرَدًّا﴾ tamyīz.

daas-irab:77-81.t: ﴿أَفَرَأَيْتَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كَفَرَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) كفر; nā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لَأُوتَيَنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of the oath, and an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil is latent; the oath clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿مالًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَوَلَداً﴾ conjoined to مالا; the clause of the answer of the oath has no grammatical position. ﴿أَطَّلَعَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْغَيْبَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَمِ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿اتَّخَذَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿الرَّحْمنِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَهْداً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَلَّا﴾ a particle of deterrence and rebuke. ﴿سَنَكْتُبُ﴾ the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَنَمُدُّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to نمد. ﴿مِنَ الْعَذابِ﴾ attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of مدا. ﴿مَدًّا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَنَرِثُهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its object; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَيَأْتِينا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, and nā is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. [Translator's note: so in the source; in يأتينا the fāʿil is a latent pronoun and nā is the object.] ﴿فَرْداً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاتَّخَذُوا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ attached to اتخذوا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿آلِهَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِيَكُونُوا﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb; the wāw is its noun. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ attached to the khabar (predicate) عزا. ﴿عِزًّا﴾ khabar.

daas-irab:82-86.t: ﴿كَلَّا﴾ a particle of rebuke. ﴿سَيَكْفُرُونَ﴾ the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿بِعِبادَتِهِمْ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) يكفرون; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَيَكُونُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb; the wāw is its noun. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ attached to ضدا. ﴿ضِدا﴾ the khabar (predicate) of يكونون. ﴿أَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and lam is a jussive particle. ﴿تَرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the weak letter; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is initial. ﴿أَنَّا﴾ composed of anna, which resembles the verb, and nā assimilated into it, which is its noun. ﴿أَرْسَلْنَا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of أنا. ﴿الشَّياطِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَلَى الْكافِرِينَ﴾ attached to أرسلنا. ﴿تَؤُزُّهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿أَزًّا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa) and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَعْجَلْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by lā; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ attached to تعجل; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining [mā] and the restrained [inna] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿نَعُدُّ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ attached to نعد. ﴿عَدًّا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to نحشر. ﴿نَحْشُرُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَى الرَّحْمنِ﴾ attached to نحشر. ﴿وَفْداً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَنَسُوقُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿إِلى جَهَنَّمَ﴾ attached to نسوق; جهنم is genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿وِرْداً﴾ ḥāl; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa).

daas-irab:87-92.t: ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَمْلِكُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿الشَّفاعَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿مَنِ﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as the excepted. ﴿اتَّخَذَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اتخذ. ﴿الرَّحْمنِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَهْداً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمنُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿وَلَداً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām is for the oath and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿جِئْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer of an oath. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِدًّا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of شيئا. ﴿تَكادُ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb. ﴿السَّماواتُ﴾ its noun. ﴿يَتَفَطَّرْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural; the nūn is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of تكاد. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to يتفطرن. ﴿وَتَنْشَقُّ الْأَرْضُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَتَخِرُّ الْجِبالُ﴾ an imperfect verb and fāʿil. ﴿هَدًّا﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَنْ﴾ maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya). ﴿دَعَوْا﴾ a past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif that was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, the letter before it being given fatḥa to indicate it. ﴿لِلرَّحْمنِ﴾ attached to دعوا. ﴿وَلَداً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَما يَنْبَغِي﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ owing to heaviness. ﴿لِلرَّحْمنِ﴾ attached to ينبغي; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle that makes the verb accusative. ﴿يَتَّخِذَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of ينبغي. ﴿وَلَداً﴾ mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:93-98.t: ﴿إِنْ﴾ a particle of negation with no governing effect. ﴿كُلُّ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿آتِي﴾ the khabar (predicate) of كل, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; the nominal clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿الرَّحْمنِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَبْداً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of an omitted oath and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَحْصاهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer of an oath. ﴿وَعَدَّهُمْ﴾ conjoined to أحصاهم, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿عَدًّا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَكُلُّهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and كل is mubtadaʾ; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿آتِيهِ﴾ khabar, nominative by the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to آتيه. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَرْداً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, the noun of inna; the clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ conjoined to آمنوا. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿سَيَجْعَلُ﴾ the sīn is for the future, and a nominative imperfect verb. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ attached to سيجعل. ﴿الرَّحْمنُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وُدًّا﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and إنما is the restraining [mā] and the restrained [inna] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يَسَّرْناهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is resumptive. [Translator's note: so in the source; يسرناه is a past verb.] ﴿بِلِسانِكَ﴾ attached to يسرناه. ﴿لِتُبَشِّرَ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to تبشر. ﴿الْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَتُنْذِرَ﴾ conjoined to تبشر, accusative like it; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to تبشر. [Translator's note: so in the source; this second بِهِ belongs with تنذر.] ﴿قَوْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لُدًّا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of قوما. ﴿وَكَمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and kam is declarative (khabariyya), in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi of أهلكنا. ﴿أَهْلَكْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿قَبْلَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to أهلكنا; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a preposition. ﴿قَرْنٍ﴾ a genitive noun, the tamyīz (specification) of kam. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿تُحِسُّ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿أَحَدٍ﴾ a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿تَسْمَعُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ attached to تسمع. ﴿رِكْزاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:1-3.t: ﴿كهيعص﴾: these letters have no grammatical position. ﴿ذِكْرُ﴾: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هذا ذكر". ﴿رَحْمَتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَبْدَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of رحمة, accusative, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿زَكَرِيَّا﴾: badal (substitute) of عبده, or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time attached (mutaʿalliq) to رحمة. ﴿نادى﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿رَبَّهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نِداءً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿خَفِيًّا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of نداء.

daas-irab:4-6.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf), accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنِّي﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿شَيْباً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَلَمْ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and لم is a particle governing the jussive. ﴿أَكُنْ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, its noun latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِدُعائِكَ﴾: the two are attached to the khabar شقيا. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed, annexed to the dropped yāʾ, accusative by an implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿شَقِيًّا﴾: the khabar of أكن. ﴿وَإِنِّي﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and inna and its noun. ﴿خِفْتُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna. ﴿الْمَوالِيَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ وَرائِي﴾: the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَكانَتِ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an incomplete past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿امْرَأَتِي﴾: its noun, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, whose appearance is prevented by the place being occupied with the vowel suited to the yāʾ; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عاقِراً﴾: khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَهَبْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِي﴾: the two are attached to هب; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ لَدُنْكَ﴾: the two are attached to هب, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلِيًّا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَرِثُنِي﴾: an imperfect verb; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), the fāʿil is latent and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of وليا. ﴿وَيَرِثُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb in the nominative whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ آلِ﴾: the two are attached to يرث. ﴿يَعْقُوبَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿وَاجْعَلْهُ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an imperative of supplication; the fāʿil is latent and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed, with an omitted vocative particle; it is an annexed munādā, accusative by an implied fatḥa on the letter before the dropped yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿رَضِيًّا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi of اجعله.

daas-irab:7-9.t: ﴿يا زَكَرِيَّا﴾: يا is a vocative particle; زكريا is the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a ḍamma implied on the alif, in the position of the accusative. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: inna, and نا, denoting the plural, is its noun. ﴿نُبَشِّرُكَ﴾: an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِغُلامٍ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to نبشرك; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنا. ﴿اسْمُهُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿يَحْيى﴾: khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of غلام. ﴿لَمْ نَجْعَلْ﴾: لم governs the jussive, and an imperfect verb; the fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُ﴾: the second object of تجعل [Translator's note: so in the source, for نجعل.]. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾: من is a preposition, and قبل is an adverb of time, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the two are attached to نجعل. ﴿سَمِيًّا﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of the genitive as a second naʿt of غلام. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed, accusative, annexed to the dropped yāʾ of the speaker; the vocative clause and what follows it are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَنَّى﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place. ﴿يَكُونُ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb. ﴿لِي﴾: the two are attached to the omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿غُلامٌ﴾: the noun of يكون; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿وَكانَتِ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an incomplete past verb, and the tāʾ is the tāʾ of the feminine. ﴿امْرَأَتِي﴾: its noun, nominative by an implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عاقِراً﴾: khabar. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿بَلَغْتُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنَ الْكِبَرِ﴾: the two are attached to بلغت. ﴿عِتِيًّا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: the two are attached to the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "الأمر كذلك"; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿قالَ رَبُّكَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلَيَّ﴾: the two are attached to the khabar هين. ﴿هَيِّنٌ﴾: khabar; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and قد is a particle of realisation. ﴿خَلَقْتُكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response to an oath. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a preposition. ﴿قَبْلُ﴾: an adverb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive by من; the two are attached to خلقتك. ﴿وَلَمْ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and لم is a particle of the jussive. ﴿تَكُ﴾: an incomplete imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by a sukūn implied on the nūn, which is dropped for lightening; its noun is latent. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾: khabar; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:10-13.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), accusative, annexed to the dropped yāʾ of the speaker; the vocative clause and what follows it are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿اجْعَلْ﴾: a verb of supplication, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِي﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to اجعل. ﴿آيَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿آيَتُكَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿أَلَّا﴾: أن is a particle governing the accusative, and لا is negative, without governing effect. ﴿تُكَلِّمَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an; the fāʿil is latent. ﴿النَّاسَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿ثَلاثَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to تكلم. ﴿لَيالٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿سَوِيًّا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ليال. ﴿فَخَرَجَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلى قَوْمِهِ﴾: the two are attached to خرج. ﴿مِنَ الْمِحْرابِ﴾: the two are attached to خرج. ﴿فَأَوْحى﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb; the fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَيْهِمْ﴾: the two are attached to أوحى. ﴿أَنْ﴾: explicative, because it comes after a clause containing the sense of saying. ﴿سَبِّحُوا﴾: an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿بُكْرَةً﴾: an adverb of time attached to سبحوا; the clause has no grammatical position because it is explicative. ﴿وَعَشِيًّا﴾: conjoined to بكرة. ﴿يا يَحْيى﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and يحيى is the one addressed, a singular proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a ḍamma implied on the alif, in the position of the accusative as vocative; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿خُذِ﴾: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِقُوَّةٍ﴾: the two are attached to the verb. ﴿وَآتَيْناهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object. ﴿الْحُكْمَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿صَبِيًّا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَحَناناً﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and حنانا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الحكم, i.e. "and We gave him حنانا". ﴿مِنْ لَدُنَّا﴾: the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of حنانا, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَزَكاةً﴾: conjoined to حنانا. ﴿وَكانَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is omitted, its implied form being "هو", i.e. Yaḥyā. ﴿تَقِيًّا﴾: the khabar of kāna.

daas-irab:14-17.t:
[Translator's note: the source entry begins with a stray fragment of the Quranic text of verses 14–17, reproduced here as it stands: «ًّا بِوالِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ جَبَّاراً عَصِيًّا (14) وَسَلامٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا (15) وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتابِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ انْتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِها مَكاناً شَرْقِيًّا (16) فَاتَّخَذَتْ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ حِجاباً فَأَرْسَلْنا إِلَيْها رُوحَنا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَها بَشَراً سَوِيًّا (17)».]
﴿وَبَرًّا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) by the wāw to تقيا. ﴿بِوالِدَيْهِ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to برا. ﴿وَلَمْ﴾: لم is a particle of the jussive. ﴿يَكُنْ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its jussive being the sukūn; its noun is latent (mustatir). ﴿جَبَّاراً﴾: its khabar (predicate). ﴿عَصِيًّا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of جبارا. ﴿وَسَلامٌ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: the two are attached to an omitted khabar, its implied form being "كائن". ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb attached to سلام. ﴿وُلِدَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يُبْعَثُ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil is latent. ﴿حَيًّا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاذْكُرْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent. ﴿فِي الْكِتابِ﴾: the two are attached to اذكر. ﴿مَرْيَمَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِذِ﴾: an adverb of time attached to انتبذت. ﴿انْتَبَذَتْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿مِنْ أَهْلِها﴾: the two are attached to انتبذت. ﴿مَكاناً﴾: an adverb of place attached to انتبذت. ﴿شَرْقِيًّا﴾: a naʿt of مكان. ﴿فَاتَّخَذَتْ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِمْ﴾: the two are attached to اتخذت. ﴿حِجاباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَأَرْسَلْنا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَيْها﴾: إلى is a preposition, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the two are attached to أرسلنا. ﴿رُوحَنا﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and نا is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿فَتَمَثَّلَ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb; the fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَها﴾: the two are attached to تمثل. ﴿بَشَراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿سَوِيًّا﴾: a naʿt of بشرا.

daas-irab:18-22.t: ﴿قالَتْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: inna and its noun; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَعُوذُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿بِالرَّحْمنِ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أعوذ. ﴿مِنْكَ﴾: the two are attached to أعوذ. إن [Translator's note: in the source ﴿إِنْ﴾ is not set apart as a Quranic word.]: a conditional particle governing the jussive. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿تَقِيًّا﴾: khabar; the clause is initial, with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) clause is omitted. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿أَنَا رَسُولُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar. ﴿رَبِّكِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِأَهَبَ﴾: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَكِ﴾: the two are attached to أهب. ﴿غُلاماً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿زَكِيًّا﴾: a naʿt (adjective). ﴿قالَتْ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّى﴾: an interrogative noun meaning "how", in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place. ﴿يَكُونُ﴾: an incomplete imperfect verb. ﴿لِي﴾: the two are attached to the omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿غُلامٌ﴾: its noun. ﴿وَلَمْ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لم is a particle of the jussive. ﴿يَمْسَسْنِي﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَشَرٌ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلَمْ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لم is a particle of the jussive. ﴿أَكُ﴾: an incomplete imperfect verb, jussive by لم; its noun is latent. ﴿بَغِيًّا﴾: khabar. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿كَذلِكِ﴾: the two are attached to the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "الأمر كذلك"; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿قالَ رَبُّكِ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and a muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌ﴾: the detached pronoun is mubtadaʾ and هين is its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar هين; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿وَلِنَجْعَلَهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām is the lām of causation, and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an; the fāʿil is latent and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آيَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾: the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of آية. ﴿وَرَحْمَةً﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to آية. ﴿مِنَّا﴾: من is a preposition, and نا is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the two are attached to رحمة. ﴿وَكانَ﴾: an incomplete past verb whose noun is latent. ﴿أَمْراً﴾: its khabar. ﴿مَقْضِيًّا﴾: a naʿt of أمر. ﴿فَحَمَلَتْهُ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَانْتَبَذَتْ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿بِهِ﴾: the two are attached to انتبذت; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَكاناً﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial). ﴿قَصِيًّا﴾: a naʿt.

daas-irab:23-25.t: ﴿فَأَجاءَهَا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, for immediate sequence; the hamza is for transitivity (taʿdiya), and a past verb, and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿الْمَخاضُ﴾: fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلى جِذْعِ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to جاء. ﴿النَّخْلَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قالَتْ﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿يا لَيْتَنِي﴾: يا is vocative or for drawing attention (tanbīh); in ليتني, ليت is a particle resembling the verb, the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is its noun; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِتُّ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of ليت. ﴿قَبْلَ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿هذا﴾: the hāʾ is for drawing attention; ذا is a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَكُنْتُ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿نَسْياً﴾: khabar. ﴿مَنْسِيًّا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of نسيا. ﴿فَناداها﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied fatḥa on the alif; the fāʿil is latent and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ تَحْتِها﴾: the two are attached to the verb ناداها. ﴿أن﴾: explicative. ﴿لا﴾: prohibitive, governing the jussive. ﴿تَحْزَنِي﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the yāʾ is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is explicative. ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَحْتَكِ﴾: an adverb of place, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿سَرِيًّا﴾: mafʿūl bihi of جعل. ﴿وَهُزِّي﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the yāʾ is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil. ﴿إِلَيْكِ﴾: the two are attached to هزي. ﴿بِجِذْعِ﴾: the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and a mafʿūl bihi genitive in form and accusative in position. ﴿النَّخْلَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تُساقِطْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the response to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab); the fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْكِ﴾: the two are attached to تساقط. ﴿رُطَباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿جَنِيًّا﴾: a naʿt.

daas-irab:26-28.t: ﴿فَكُلِي﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "if all this is accomplished for you, eat"; and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the yāʾ is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَاشْرَبِي﴾: an imperative verb conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَقَرِّي﴾: an imperative verb conjoined to what precedes it, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿عَيْناً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿فَإِمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and إما is conditional (إن), its nūn assimilated into the redundant ما. ﴿تَرَيِنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb is ordinarily parsed as indeclinable (mabnī), being attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of the jussive as the protasis.], and the yāʾ is the fāʿil. ﴿مِنَ الْبَشَرِ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَحَداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَقُولِي﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the yāʾ is a pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition [Translator's note: so in the source, although إِمّا (إن) is a jussive conditional particle.]. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: inna is a particle resembling the verb, and the yāʾ is its noun; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿نَذَرْتُ﴾: an indeclinable past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿لِلرَّحْمنِ﴾: the two are attached to نذرت. ﴿صَوْماً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَلَنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and لن is a particle governing the accusative. ﴿أُكَلِّمَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to أكلم. ﴿إِنْسِيًّا﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَأَتَتْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb, indeclinable on a fatḥa implied on the dropped alif; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿قَوْمَها﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تَحْمِلُهُ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative; the fāʿil is latent and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا مَرْيَمُ﴾: the yāʾ [Translator's note: i.e. the particle يا.] is vocative, and مريم is the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative as vocative; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾: the lām occurs in the response to the omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿جِئْتِ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response to an oath [Translator's note: the source has «قم», a misprint for «قسم» (oath).]. ﴿فَرِيًّا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of شيئا. ﴿يا أُخْتَ﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أخت is an annexed munādā, accusative as vocative. ﴿هارُونَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿ما كانَ أَبُوكِ﴾: ما is negative, and kāna and its noun, nominative by the wāw because it is one of the five nouns, and the kāf is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿امْرَأَ﴾: khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَوْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما كانَتْ أُمُّكِ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive and ما is negative, and kāna and its noun, and the kāf is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿بَغِيًّا﴾: khabar; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:29-31.t: ﴿فَأَشارَتْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أشارت. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw, the wāw of the plural, is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿نُكَلِّمُ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كانَ﴾: kāna, and its noun is a latent pronoun. ﴿فِي الْمَهْدِ﴾: the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿صَبِيًّا﴾: the khabar (predicate) of kāna; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿عَبْدُ﴾: the khabar of inna; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿آتانِيَ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), the fāʿil is latent, and the yāʾ is in the position of the accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿وَجَعَلَنِي﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a past verb; the nūn is the nūn of protection, the fāʿil is latent and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نَبِيًّا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَجَعَلَنِي﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a past verb whose i'rab has preceded, and the yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مُبارَكاً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَيْنَ ما﴾: an adverb of place, accusative, attached to the verb جعل. ﴿كُنْتُ﴾: kāna and its noun; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَوْصانِي﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a past verb; the fāʿil is latent, the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi and the nūn is the nūn of protection. ﴿بِالصَّلاةِ﴾: the two are attached to أوصاني. ﴿وَالزَّكاةِ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الصلاة; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾: maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar). ﴿دُمْتُ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and the tāʾ is in the position of the nominative as its noun. ﴿حَيًّا﴾: its khabar; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the accusative as an adverb of time.

daas-irab:32-34.t: ﴿وَبَرًّا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and برا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to مباركا. ﴿بِوالِدَتِي﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to برا, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِي﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿جَبَّاراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿شَقِيًّا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of جبارا; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿وَالسَّلامُ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and السلام is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلَيَّ﴾: the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to ولدت. ﴿وُلِدْتُ﴾: a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and an adverb of time attached to أموت. ﴿أَمُوتُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ﴾: its i'rab is like the i'rab of يوم أموت. ﴿حَيًّا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿عِيسَى﴾: khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ابْنُ﴾: badal (substitute) of عيسى. ﴿مَرْيَمَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote, owing to being a proper name and feminine. ﴿قَوْلَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "قلت". ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive as a naʿt of الحق. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: the two are attached to يمترون. ﴿يَمْتَرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:35-36.t: ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the fronted khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾: governing the accusative. ﴿يَتَّخِذَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); an and the verb, interpreted as a maṣdar, are in the position of the nominative as the noun of kāna. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿وَلَدٍ﴾: a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يتخذ. ﴿سُبْحانَهُ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "أسبح". ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb of time for the future, governing its protasis in the genitive and attached to its apodosis. ﴿قَضى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَمْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾: the fāʾ is linking, and إنما is restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يَقُولُ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿لَهُ﴾: the two are attached to يقول. ﴿كُنْ﴾: an incomplete imperative; its noun is latent and its khabar omitted, its implied form being "بشرا"; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَيَكُونُ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: khabar, nominative by an implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, whose appearance is prevented by the place being occupied with the vowel suited to the yāʾ; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَرَبُّكُمْ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ربي, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَاعْبُدُوهُ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿هذا﴾: the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿صِراطٌ﴾: khabar. ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٌ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of صراط; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:37-39.t: ﴿فَاخْتَلَفَ الْأَحْزابُ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ بَيْنِهِمْ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَوَيْلٌ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and a mubtadaʾ (subject); beginning with an indefinite noun is allowed because it carries the sense of supplication. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: the lām is a preposition, and a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ مَشْهَدِ﴾: the two are attached to ويل. ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَظِيمٍ﴾: a naʿt (adjective). ﴿أَسْمِعْ﴾: a past verb that comes in the form of the imperative; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, added to the fāʿil, and its pronoun comes as an accusative pronoun to suit the bāʾ. ﴿وَأَبْصِرْ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أسمع, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿يَأْتُونَنا﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and نا is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لكِنِ﴾: lightened from لكنّ, without governing effect. ﴿الظَّالِمُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ, nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿فِي ضَلالٍ﴾: the two are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾: a naʿt; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَأَنْذِرْهُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperative verb and its first object, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْحَسْرَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time attached to الحسرة. ﴿قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ﴾: a passive past verb and a nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and هم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي غَفْلَةٍ﴾: the two are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: لا is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:40-42.t: ﴿إِنَّا﴾: inna, the particle resembling the verb, and نا, assimilated into it, is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنا. ﴿نَرِثُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar of نحن. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and من is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الأرض. ﴿عَلَيْها﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَإِلَيْنا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and the two are attached to يرجعون. ﴿يُرْجَعُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاذْكُرْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي الْكِتابِ﴾: the two are attached to اذكر. ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna, and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause is an explanation of cause (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; the clause is the khabar of إنه, and its noun is latent. ﴿صِدِّيقاً﴾: khabar. ﴿نَبِيًّا﴾: a second khabar. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time attached to صديقا. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِأَبِيهِ﴾: the two are attached to قال, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿أَبَتِ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the yāʾ, which is replaced by the tāʾ; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لِمَ﴾: the lām is a preposition, and ما is an interrogative noun in the position of the genitive, its alif dropped because the preposition comes before it; the two are attached to تعبد. ﴿تَعْبُدُ﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يَسْمَعُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا يُبْصِرُ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding one; it is conjoined to يسمع. ﴿وَلا يُغْنِي﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿عَنْكَ﴾: the two are attached to يغني. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:43-45.t: ﴿يا أَبَتِ﴾: its i'rab has passed in the previous verse. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: inna and its noun; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿جاءَنِي﴾: a past verb; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is its fronted object. ﴿مِنَ الْعِلْمِ﴾: the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to جاءني. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as a postponed fāʿil (agent). ﴿لَمْ﴾: a particle governing the jussive. ﴿يَأْتِكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; the kāf is its object and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿فَاتَّبِعْنِي﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, because it discloses a prior condition, the implied form being "إن شئت الهداية فاتبعني"; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَهْدِكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the response to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the kāf is its first object and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿صِراطاً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿سَوِيًّا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of صراطا. ﴿يا أَبَتِ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in the previous verse. ﴿لا﴾: prohibitive. ﴿تَعْبُدِ﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive, vowelled with kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿الشَّيْطانَ﴾: its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿إِنَّ الشَّيْطانَ﴾: inna and its noun; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿لِلرَّحْمنِ﴾: the two are attached to the khabar عصيا. ﴿عَصِيًّا﴾: khabar. ﴿يا أَبَتِ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: inna, and the yāʾ is its noun; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿أَخافُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of إني. ﴿أَنْ﴾: governing the accusative. ﴿يَمَسَّكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, and the kāf is its object. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾: a postponed fāʿil. ﴿مِنَ الرَّحْمنِ﴾: the two are attached to يمسك. ﴿فَتَكُونَ﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and an incomplete imperfect verb whose noun is omitted, its implied form being "أنت". ﴿لِلشَّيْطانِ﴾: the two are attached to the khabar وليا. ﴿وَلِيًّا﴾: khabar; the clause is conjoined.
